description: Develop GitHub issues using Git worktrees, validation and pull requests. Use neige_dev_publish to publish; kernel permissions and plugin enablement still apply.

exposes_tools.name: git_worktree_add
exposes_tools.description: Lower git worktree add into a forge action

branch.description: Optional branch name to create for the worktree

exposes_tools.name: git_commit
exposes_tools.description: Lower git commit into a forge action

message.description: Commit message to pass to git commit

idem.description: Idempotency key for the commit action

branch.description: Optional branch name expected after committing

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_list
exposes_tools.description: Lower GitHub pull request overlap scans into a forge action

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

base.description: Base branch to filter pull requests

head.description: Head branch to filter pull requests

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_diff
exposes_tools.description: Read a GitHub pull request diff. The call waits and returns result.event.artifact_path, the file holding the full patch

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

base_sha.description: Base commit SHA for the diff

head_sha.description: Head commit SHA for the diff

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_checks
exposes_tools.description: Park this call to wait for a pull request's checks on its current head. Returns a pending receipt; the kernel wakes you with forge.pr.checks naming the exact head_sha, CI conclusion and mergeable when every check has finished or as soon as any check fails, when the PR is conflicting, when the head moves, or after about 15-20 minutes. While pending, repeating the same call returns the same receipt and adds no information. After the wake, repeat the same call to read the recorded result, including all failed check names and job URLs or IDs. Use a new attempt for each new wait.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_merge
exposes_tools.description: Lower GitHub pull request merges into a forge action

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

expected_head_sha.description: Optional expected head commit SHA for merge fencing

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_view
exposes_tools.description: Lower GitHub issue views into a forge action

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

attempt.description: Use a new attempt for a fresh read; reuse it when retrying.

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_close
exposes_tools.description: Lower GitHub issue closes into a forge action

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_comment
exposes_tools.description: Post an issue comment through the kernel. Reuse idem and body on retries; use a new idem for another comment.

idem.description: Stable identity for this logical comment

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_comments
exposes_tools.description: Read issue discussion as JSON; use a new attempt to refresh.

repo.description: Optional owner/name, parsed from issue_url at the entry surface

merge_policy.description: hold-for-ratify (default when absent): ask the user with neige_user_ask before gh_pr_merge; auto-merge: merge after review and green checks without asking again

notes.description: Optional free-form context from the requester
